name: Wan 2.1 Period-Separated Beats
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: In Wan 2.1 prompts, commas merge simultaneous descriptors while PERIODS separate sequential temporal beats. Write distinct actions as crisp sequential sentences (`She walks past the neon doorway. She pauses under the rain and glances upward.`) rather than comma soup.

name: I2V Zero-Redundancy Motion Delta
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: When animating a reference anchor via Wan 2.1 VACE, do NOT waste tokens re-describing static background props the vision/VAE encoder already sees—dedicate tokens strictly to what changes, shifts lighting, or moves over time.

name: CausVid 6-Step Sampler Guardrails
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: For distilled `CausVid` Wan 2.1 1.3B (`LoRA strength 0.40–0.50`), keep `steps=6–8`, `cfg=1.0–1.5`, `shift=5.5–8.0`, and `uni_pc` or `euler` (`simple`/`normal`); avoid high CFG (>2.5) or ancestral samplers which distort 6-step latents.

name: Wan Temporal 4n+1 Frame Cadence
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Match Wan 2.1 3D causal VAE alignment strictly using `4n + 1` frame counts (`17`, `33`, `49`, `81`) paired with clean integer step pacing so motion decodes without temporal stutter at clip boundaries.

name: Explicit Motion Amplitude Calibration
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Quantify motion strength explicitly in Wan prompts (`gentle unhurried swaying`, `deliberate steady stride`, `explosive rapid shatter`, `subtle quiet breathing`) so outputs avoid dead-static stiffness or chaotic warp.

name: Narrative-Driven Camera Purpose
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Pair every camera path with narrative motivation (`camera slowly pushes in as shadows tighten across her face` or `camera pulls backward revealing the cavernous hangar around him`) instead of orphaned movement labels.

name: Wan Native Grid & 720p Lanczos Scale
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Sample Wan 2.1 1.3B cleanly on mod-16 native grids (`640×368` or `832×480`), then master upward via `ffmpeg scale=1280:720:flags=lanczos` + mild `unsharp=5:5:0.75` rather than forcing unstable high native latent sizes on 8 GB UMA.

name: Wan Temporal Anti-Flicker Negatives
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Filter temporal degradation explicitly: target `static frames, flickering, blurry motion, morphing anatomy, repetitive patterns, washed-out colors` while keeping clean exposure/lighting positive descriptors.
negative_prompt_patch: static frames, flickering, blurry motion, morphing, repetitive patterns, washed-out colors

name: Sliding Window Overlap Tail Continuity
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Extend Wan 2.1 sequences reliably by extracting crisp non-blurred tail anchor frames into subsequent VACE windows (`SolidMask(0.0)` reference frame lock), maintaining uninterrupted directional lighting and camera momentum.

name: VACE White Pseudo-Mask Inpainting
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: For Wan VACE masked edits, use solid high-contrast mask regions (`Screen blend white pixels`) isolating only the target zone so surrounding frames stay locked with zero pixel shimmer.

name: Multi-Condition Depth + Pose Fidelity
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: When guiding rapid human choreography (`dance`, `sparring`, `gymnastics`), constrain both `Depth Anything V2` spatial volume and `DWPose` limb skeletons together so arms and torsos never detach or sprout phantom joints.

name: Subject Reference-to-Video Lock
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Lock core identity invariants concisely (`dark bob hair, crimson scarf, weathered slate coat`) near prompt start and avoid swapping clothing materials mid-clip so character identity persists through head turns.

name: Flow Shift Stability Control
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Moderate `ModelSamplingSD3(shift)` between `5.0` and `6.5` for calm scenic or subtle portrait video (`less frame warping`), reserving higher `7.0–8.0` shifts only when bold rapid scene motion is desired.

name: Block-Skip Cache Safety Margins
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: When accelerating DiT inference (`TeaCache rel_l1_thresh 0.15–0.20` or SlG skip-blocks), preserve full early denoising steps for silhouette layout and apply caching only across redundant mid-to-late refinement passes.

name: UMT5-XXL Natural Prose Structuring
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: UMT5-XXL understands full grammatical English prose much better than fragmented Danbooru tags. Replace broken buzzword strings with fluent active sentences describing subject, motion physics, light spill, and lens.

name: Wan 5-Part Director Formula
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Compose every Wan video prompt strictly in 5 clear dimensions: `[Camera Path & Lens] + [Entity Appearance] + [Physical Action Beats] + [Environment & Atmospheric Light] + [Film Texture]`.

name: Eliminating Aimless Screensaver Drift
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Prevent lazy floating screensaver outputs by binding concrete subject interaction with the floor/air (`boots crunch across frost`, `sleeve snags wind`, `camera trucks beside moving bumper`) rather than vague scenic nouns.

name: Physical Dolly vs Optical Lens Zoom
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Prefer explicit physical motion (`camera physically dollies forward past foreground pillars`) over vague `zoom in`—physical dolly preserves rich 3D parallax between near objects and distant sky.

name: Flicker-Free Light Source Anchoring
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Stabilize frame-to-frame luminance in Wan outputs by anchoring one clear constant key light source (`steady overcast north skylight` or `fixed amber streetlamp overhead`) unless flashing effects are explicitly desired.

name: Clean Single-Axis Trajectory Discipline
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: On compact 1.3B checkpoints, instruct one clean primary camera axis per 4s clip (`slow lateral truck left` OR `steady forward glide`) rather than simultaneous tilt+roll+zoom combinations.

name: 24fps 180° Natural Motion Blur
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Anchor filmic cadence with `shot at 24fps, 180-degree shutter natural motion blur on fast gestures` so motion interpolates silkily into crisp 720p playback without robotic choppiness.

name: Soft Foreground Occluder Parallax
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Pass a softly defocused near-lens element (`damp pine branch`, `rusty steel girder`, `rain-streaked doorway edge`) gently across one frame edge during lateral tracking to triple perceived 3D cinema depth.

name: Architectural Horizon Anchor Stability
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Name crisp structural background geometry (`vertical dark granite pillars`, `level ocean horizon`, `parallel window frames`) so Wan's spatial attention preserves rigid perspective during fast actor motion.

name: Cross-Frame White-Balance Consistency
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Lock consistent color grading tokens (`consistent Kodak neutral daylight white balance, controlled contrast, crisp blacks`) to avoid slow sepia or mud saturation creep toward final frames.

name: Low-VRAM 1.3B Video Scene Complexity
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Optimize scenes for 1.3B clarity: showcase 1–2 distinct focal subjects against legible high-contrast lighting instead of 20 tiny distant overlapping figures whose limbs compete for latent pixels.
